modules.title: 从浅色到深色时，哪些界面值必须一起变化
深色模式是一套主题状态

items.title: 颜色关系要整体切换
items.text: 背景变深后，正文、弱提示、边框、按钮、输入框、图表和代码块都要重新检查对比与层级；不能只反转一个底色。

items.title: 用户偏好需要被尊重
items.text: 产品可读取系统的 `prefers-color-scheme` 作为默认，也可提供明确切换并记住用户选择。切换后焦点、悬停、选中和错误状态仍必须可辨认。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 深色模式不等于深色视觉风格。后者可能是一个固定页面的艺术选择；深色模式是与浅色模式对应、可依据系统或用户偏好切换的整套界面状态。它也不保证所有设备都会省电。

lessonPractice.title: 背景改成深灰以后，输入框边界和错误提示几乎看不见。下一步应该检查什么？

options.label: 检查文字、边框、错误和焦点在深色背景上是否清楚
options.feedback: 对。深色模式是整套界面状态，关键操作和反馈都必须继续清楚。

options.label: 复用浅色模式的边框和错误色，只反转背景与正文颜色
options.feedback: 背景更黑不会自动让边界、提示和焦点可辨认，反而可能降低可读性。

options.label: 给所有输入框统一加白色描边，错误状态继续使用同一种边框
options.feedback: 统一白边可能让输入框可见，却抹掉普通、错误和焦点状态的差异；这些状态需要分别检查对比度。

en.title: After the team changes a page background to dark gray, input borders and error messages are almost invisible. What should happen next?

options.label: Audit text, borders, inputs, errors, focus, and charts for contrast and state in the dark theme—not only the background
options.feedback: Correct. Dark mode is a full interface state, so key actions and feedback must remain clear.

options.label: Make the background even blacker; no other colors need change
options.feedback: A darker background does not automatically make borders, feedback, and focus discernible and may reduce readability.

options.label: Hide error messages to make the dark page cleaner
options.feedback: Errors remain feedback needed to complete a task; deleting them does not solve contrast.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请实现深色模式：默认可参考系统 `prefers-color-scheme`，并提供用户切换。背景、文字、边框、输入框、错误、焦点、图表和代码块都要有对应主题值；改完后检查浅色和深色下的默认、悬停、聚焦和错误状态。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Implement dark mode: use system `prefers-color-scheme` as a possible default and provide a user switch. Give background, text, borders, inputs, errors, focus, charts, and code blocks matching theme values. Then check default, hover, focus, and error states in both light and dark modes.

learning.assumes: You have used light and dark appearance switching in an app or operating system.
learning.outcome: You can check that dark mode covers important interface states and contrast instead of only checking whether the background became black.

modules.title: Which interface values must change together from light to dark
Dark mode is a complete theme state

items.title: Color relationships change together
items.text: When backgrounds become dark, body text, muted hints, borders, buttons, inputs, charts, and code blocks all need contrast and hierarchy checks. Reversing one background alone is insufficient.

items.title: Respect a person's preference
items.text: A product can use `prefers-color-scheme` as a default and offer an explicit switch that remembers a choice. Focus, hover, selected, and error states must remain distinguishable after switching.

modules.title: What it is not
modules.text: Dark mode is not the same as a dark visual style. The latter can be a fixed artistic choice for one page; dark mode is a full set of interface states that corresponds to light mode and can follow system or user preference. It also does not guarantee lower power use on every device.

distinctions.label: Dark tech style
distinctions.text: {c:dark-mode} is a product theme that can be switched or follow the system. {c:style-dark-tech} is a visual style that consistently uses dark surfaces and technology-themed graphics.
